findings.title: Audit field config bloats oversized service modules
findings.problem: code-quality.md Module Cohesion forbids appending a new concern's own constants and pure functions to a ~500+ line module that does not own it. The change adds four audit field frozensets (lines 75-80) and the pure helpers _project_budget_update_attributes, _group_update_attributes and _emit_group_updated_event (711-730, 2139-2173) to the 2641-line project_budget_service.py, audit field sets to budget_service.py (1744 lines, 61-72), and _PROJECT_AUDIT_* sets plus _project_audit_snapshot to project_service.py (995 lines, 57-73).
findings.impact: code-quality.md is a documented blocking standard and this is the exact pattern its cohesion rule names; audit-attribute configuration grows already oversized CRUD services instead of living beside the change-diff helper it wraps.
findings.recommendation: Move the audit field sets (_PROJECT_BUDGET_AUDIT_*, _GROUP_AUDIT_* in project_budget_service.py; _BUDGET_AUDIT_* in budget_service.py:61-72; _PROJECT_AUDIT_* and _project_audit_snapshot in project_service.py:57-73) and the pure attribute-builder helpers (_project_budget_update_attributes, _group_update_attributes) into a dedicated audit module next to src/codemie/service/activity/activity_attributes.py (or a budget audit module) and import them from the services.

fix.change: Audit field sets, project_audit_snapshot and pure attribute builders moved to service/activity/change_audit.py; services import them
fix.test: n/a (existing budget/project/activity suites unchanged and green)

findings.title: Models change lacks previous value and diff
findings.problem: _project_budget_update_attributes appends "models" to updated_fields and writes new_models whenever data.models is supplied, without comparing to the current allow-list and without ever emitting previous_models.
findings.impact: Every project budget PATCH that carries models (even an identical list) is audited as a models change, and the event cannot show what the models were before, contradicting the agreed flat previous_<f>/new_<f> attribute shape that this ticket was reopened to deliver.
findings.recommendation: Capture the current model allow-list before _sync_updated_project_budget runs, pass it into _project_budget_update_attributes, add previous_models alongside new_models, and only append "models" to updated_fields when the normalized current list differs from the requested one.

fix.change: Previous model allow-list snapshotted from provider raw metadata before sync; models listed with previous_models/new_models only when the order-insensitive lists differ (only new_models when previous is unknown)
fix.test: n/a (no new tests per user rule)

findings.title: project_name missing on name/description-only budget edits
findings.problem: In update_project_budget, _assignment stays None unless amounts or models change, so a name/description-only edit produces PROJECT_BUDGET_UPDATED attributes with no project_name (and logs project_name=None).
findings.impact: Audit events for the same event type carry project_name inconsistently, so rename/description edits of a project budget cannot be attributed to their project from the event details.
findings.recommendation: When _assignment is still None after the sync branch, load it with project_budget_assignment_repository.get_active_by_budget_id(session, budget_id) (or equivalent) so project_name is always present in PROJECT_BUDGET_UPDATED attributes and in the completion log line.

fix.change: update_project_budget loads the active assignment when sync did not, so project_name is always in PROJECT_BUDGET_UPDATED and the completion log
fix.test: n/a (no new tests per user rule)

findings.title: Group categories always reported as changed
findings.problem: _group_update_attributes diffs requested categories against previous_values, but update_project_budget_group never stores a categories key in previous_values; build_change_attributes normalizes the missing key to None, so any PATCH that includes categories lists "categories" in updated_fields.
findings.impact: Group update events claim a category distribution change whenever categories are submitted, including resubmission of the identical split, so the audit misreports what changed.
findings.recommendation: Populate previous_values["categories"] from current_result.categories (per-category pct / amount spec in the same shape as the request) before diffing, so "categories" lands in updated_fields only when the submitted distribution actually differs; keep it name-only.

fix.change: previous_values['categories'] built from current categories as {pct, soft_budget} cents-rounded specs keyed by submitted categories and compared to the requested specs
fix.test: n/a (no new tests per user rule)

findings.title: No-op group PATCH emits empty update event
findings.problem: The scalar-only early return now always calls _emit_group_updated_event; an empty PATCH (all fields None) or one whose values equal the current ones emits PROJECT_BUDGET_GROUP_UPDATED with empty updated_fields. The same unconditional emission exists on the notification-only and full exit paths.
findings.impact: Produces audit entries rendered as 'Attributes: -' for requests that changed nothing, the exact symptom QA reopened the ticket for.
findings.recommendation: Build the attributes first and only call _emit_group_updated_event when attributes["updated_fields"] is non-empty (apply the same guard on all three exit paths of update_project_budget_group).

fix.change: _emit_group_updated_event returns without inserting when updated_fields is empty, covering all three group PATCH exits
fix.test: n/a (no new tests per user rule)

findings.title: Previous total_amount uses unrounded float sum
findings.problem: previous_values["total_amount"] is ProjectBudgetGroupFullResult.total_amount, a plain float sum of per-category max_budget values computed from Decimal-split amounts, compared by equality against the requested total.
findings.impact: Float accumulation noise can make an unchanged total appear changed (e.g. 99.99999999999999 -> 100.0) and records an ugly previous value. Reachability unconfirmed: depends on the category split producing a non-exact float sum.
findings.recommendation: Round the previous total to cents before diffing, e.g. previous_values["total_amount"] = float(Decimal(str(current_result.total_amount)).quantize(_CENT)), and compare the requested total the same way.

fix.change: Previous and new group total_amount rounded to cents via round_amount before diffing
fix.test: n/a (no new tests per user rule)

findings.title: Unpersisted total_amount change recorded in audit
findings.problem: A group PATCH with total_amount but no categories passes the notification-only return, skips _update_group_categories (the only writer of category amounts; _update_group_scalar_fields writes only name/description/duration), yet _group_update_attributes still diffs data.total_amount and emits previous_total_amount/new_total_amount.
findings.impact: The audit log states a budget total changed when no amount was written, giving a false billing record of a limit change.
findings.recommendation: Only include total_amount in the audited request when it was actually applied (data.categories is not None); otherwise drop it from the requested map in _group_update_attributes so the event never claims an amount change that was not written.

fix.change: total_amount audited only when categories were applied, using the persisted total from the reloaded group
fix.test: n/a (no new tests per user rule)

findings.title: No-op allowed-models write emits empty PROJECT_UPDATED
findings.problem: _persist_allowed_models now inserts a PROJECT_UPDATED event unconditionally; reset_allowed_models on a project with no allow-list, or an update with the current values, produces an event with empty updated_fields.
findings.impact: Adds new detail-less 'Attributes: -' project.updated entries for writes that changed nothing, reproducing the reopened symptom on a newly added emission path.
findings.recommendation: Insert the PROJECT_UPDATED activity event only when change_attributes["updated_fields"] is non-empty (e.g. reset_allowed_models on a project with no allow-list, or an identical update).

fix.change: _persist_allowed_models inserts PROJECT_UPDATED only when updated_fields is non-empty
fix.test: n/a (no new tests per user rule)
